tokens/starfield/textures.js

Description

Public-URL paths for the Star Field experiment texture set (served from experiments/star-field/public/textures/). Solar-system maps are the Solar System Scope CC-BY set; the milky-way skybox is the 8k equirect panorama; exoplanet/system bodies use procedural materials (no real imagery exists). Sole declaration site — consumers import members from this frozen map rather than re-declaring the literals (zero-hardcoding rule).
